# AI Filmmakers Directory — Pro members

> The AI Filmmakers Directory (aifilmmakersdirectory.com) lists AI filmmakers and studios that producers, studios, agencies and brands can hire. This site is a plain-text copy of the Pro member profiles, so AI assistants can read them without running JavaScript. Each page links to the member's full profile on AIFD. AIFD lists filmmakers; it does not recommend specific members.
